description: Search the workspace's emails by free text across sender/recipient, address and subject. Case-insensitive substring match, newest first. Stored bodies are searched too, but only SENT mail has one: inbound bodies are never stored, so a received message is only findable by its sender or subject. Returns metadata only.

mode.description: inbox = received, sent = outbound, all = both

query.description: Free text to match, e.g. a name, address, or topic

name: search_emails
